verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs describe templates as the way it sets up a rented machine with the needed software (vast-ai-docs-30). They advertise launching prebuilt or custom templates with one click (vast-ai-docs-13) and list PyTorch, vLLM and ComfyUI deployments you can copy (vast-ai-docs-27). The CLI also manages templates (vast-ai-docs-2). Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA template is not evidenced, there are no detailed docs on the catalog of prebuilt templates, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that launching from these templates works.
